description: Source code implementing TCP socket transport functions for MQTT client in Zephyr OS, including connect, write, write message, read, and disconnect operations.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tcp_connect
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to the MQTT broker using socket API.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tcp_write
methods.description: Sends data over the TCP socket to the MQTT broker.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tcp_write_msg
methods.description: Sends a message composed of multiple buffers over TCP socket.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tcp_read
methods.description: Reads data from the TCP socket, optionally blocking.
